funding_notes: Captify (captify.glass, linked from its SPC page), San Francisco Bay Area; prescription-ready AI captioning smart glasses for deaf/hard-of-hearing people. Founders Tom Pritsky and Jason Gui; founded 2025. Finalist and Audience Choice winner of the 2026 VSP Vision Innovation Challenge (Mar 13 2026, Vision Expo); VSP said selected startups could potentially get a $400K THINC Ventures investment, but no award or investment to Captify was announced. No press release or reputable news of a priced round or amount; only SPC's early accelerator-style check is evident (a paid tracker lists undisclosed seed deals, not used). Not to be confused with UK adtech company Captify (captifytechnologies.com).
